rationale: The exact immediate resize/focus/Space sequence reproduced two misses in 20 attempts. In both traces resize replaces the focused tile DOM between Space keydown and keyup; no native click follows keyup, so the engine never receives a tile click. This is the driver firing keyboard input before viewport event processing settles. Twenty two-RAF-settled resize cases and ten steady Enter/Space cases all work with the same published artifact. A pending resize cancelling an in-progress native activation is not a persistent blocked input or unintended tile removal. The original first failure had no trace; this records a reproduced mechanism, not a claim to have captured its historical event sequence.

final_root_cause: Resize-driven tile DOM replacement can occur between keydown and keyup when the browser driver immediately inputs Space after setViewportSize resolves; the native button click is cancelled. Waiting for viewport/render stabilization fixes the assertion baseline without changing game input.
